facts.value: The Geography section within the School of History and Geography affords prospective students the opportunity to pursue a wide range of potential research topics in an engaged and supportive environment.
Staff have a broad range of research interests, from the environment and sustainability through to place and emotions, historical geography and the history of cartography.
Staff are also experts in the use of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for research and teaching, having worked in industry roles as well as academia.
